entry.title: New: BILL006(24) (Honolulu) — PUBLISH
entry.content:
RELATING TO PERMITS.

Provides explicit authority to a building official to administer and enforce provisions relating to building permits. Authorizes a building official to enter property under certain circumstances to perform a duty imposed by certain codes. Authorizes a building official to obtain an administrative warrant to enter property in certain circumstances. Requires a permittee to post or remove certain documents relating to the authority to conduct work on a property within the City and County of Honolulu, including notices to suspend or revoke a permit and stop work orders.

Latest action: Final reading notice published in the Honolulu Star-Advertiser.
